literal: Rare benefit analyzing those of wisdom will not say great benefit lacking word.
translation: The wise, who seek out rare and meaningful benefits, will not speak words that lack great purpose.
modern: அரிய பயன்களை ஆராய்ந்து அறியும் அறிஞர்கள், மிகுந்த பயன் தராத சொற்களைச் சொல்ல மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the careful speech of the truly wise. The word 'அரும்பயன்' refers to rare, profound benefits that wise people constantly seek and analyze. Because their minds are focused on such valuable pursuits, they naturally avoid trivialities. Therefore, they will never utter words that do not yield a substantial, great benefit.
